name: Patient changes intent mid-call

metadata.notes: Manually designed test scenario for healthcare AI phone-agent evaluation. Observations are preliminary notes for later review, not confirmed bugs or formal bug reports.

goal: Test whether the healthcare agent follows the patient's latest intent when they start by asking to schedule, then change course to a different question, and finally decide whether to book.

patient.name: Grace Okonkwo
patient.initial_intent: Schedule a sick visit for a sore throat
patient.mid_call_question: Clinic hours and whether walk-ins are accepted
patient.final_intent: Do not schedule now; ask for a callback tomorrow morning instead
patient.symptoms: Sore throat for two days, no fever

conversation_beats: Start by asking to schedule a sick visit for a sore throat.
After the agent begins collecting scheduling details, change your mind and ask about clinic hours and walk-ins instead.
Answer any symptom or identity questions briefly if they still ask.
Decide you do not want to schedule right now.
Ask for a callback tomorrow morning instead of booking an appointment.
Provide your name and date of birth if needed for the callback request.
Confirm that no appointment should be booked on this call.
